name: Beekeeper Bumble
blurb: Found humming in a cage of brambles, entirely unbothered. The bees were furious on their behalf.

name: Gravekeeper Mortimer
blurb: The marsh tried to keep them. They asked it politely to reconsider.

name: Chef Basil
blurb: Frozen mid-garnish. The plating survived. Priorities intact.

name: Madame Wobble
blurb: Saw the rescue coming last Tuesday. Waited anyway — it's politer to be surprised.
